title: Part Four, Chapter 1: The Cries on the Mountains

verses.t: And then many towns were founded, and each of the tribes gathered together, and they settled near the roads, and their roads were plain to see. And no one knew where Balam-quitzé, Balam-acab, Mahucutah and Yquibalam went about; but when they saw the people passing along the road, they would go up onto the peaks of the mountains and only howl like coyotes, wildcats, pumas and jaguars, imitating their cries. And the peoples, seeing this, that they went about crossing back and forth continually and only howled like coyotes, like wildcats, like pumas and jaguars, said, "They must think that the people of the towns are not men, and they must want to deceive us by doing this. They want something, and they are not ashamed to do what they want with this roaring of puma and jaguar that they make when they see people; and when they see one or two, they want to destroy them from among us." And every day they came with their wives to their dwellings, and they brought only the grubs of hornets and wasps, and honeycombs, and gave them to their wives every day. And then they went before Tohil, Avilix and Hacavitz, and said in their hearts, "We give Tohil, Avilix and Hacavitz only the blood of the deer and the birds, and we pierce only our ears and our elbows. Let us ask Tohil, Avilix and Hacavitz to give us strength and might. What can this be, these deaths of our people, who are killing us one by one?" they said among themselves, when they went before Tohil, Avilix and Hacavitz, when they pierced their ears and elbows before the god and smeared their blood and put it on the mouth of the stone. And truly they were not stones, but were like children when they arrived. And the chiefs rejoiced at that blood, and then there was a sign of their works: "Win their tails from them, and so you will save yourselves, for this came from there, from Tulanzú, when you carried us," it was said to them. And then the hide called Pazilizib was given them, and the blood with which they smear themselves; and it was blood from their backs that Tohil, Avilix and Hacavitz gave them.
